'''Tirgee Benyalle''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a crime boss on [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]] and used her control of the illegal gambling operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to take control of Kaal in the wake of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] withdrawal.

==Biography==
Tirgee Benyalle was a crime boss on [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]] who exercised control of the planet's illegal gambling and entertainment industry. After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] defeat in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Imperial forces withdrew from Kaal. Benyalle used her wealth and influence to move into the power vacuum, becoming Kaal's ruler and keeping the planet independent.<ref name="The Kaal Connection" />

She used her funds to build Kaal's aquaculture industry until, in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], she realized that she needed outside investment to expand it any further. She solicited outside powers to come to Kaal and negotiate for Kaal's aquacultural exports, and received [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Uther Kermen|Kermen]], representing the Empire; [[Utoxx Prentioch]], a nearby [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]; [[Talon Karrde]], posing as [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] Pandis Hart of the [[Sif-Uwana Council]]; and a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] delegation.<ref name="The Kaal Connection" />

Benyalle received the group at her [[Grand Imperial]] hotel and casino, hosting a high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game for the negotiators the night before the talks began. The next morning, she took the parties on a tour of a [[harvester factory]] and then began accepting bids aboard her luxury [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]]. Kermen, however, revealed a plan to retake Kaal by force, and he, his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] bodyguards, and the agents with which he had surreptitiously replaced most of the barge's crew attacked Benyalle. She was defended by Karrde, the New Republic delegation, and loyal crew members, but Kermen had bribed her bodyguard [[Sendir]] to betray her. The New Republic agents saved her from Sendir's attack, and escaped with her onto a [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] summoned by Karrde.<ref name="The Kaal Connection" />

Karrde explained that he had only been interested in the wreck of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal yacht, [[Emperor's Shadow (shuttle)|''Emperor's Shadow'']], which he had destroyed to cover their getaway. Benyalle was thus left to make her export deal with the New Republic.<ref name="The Kaal Connection" />
